name: Gachi: Christmas Party 🎄
source:
Welcome to "Gachi: Christmas Party 🎄" a visual novel filled with hilarious and heartwarming moments set against the backdrop of a festive holiday party. Will you find love under the mistletoe or will you end up alone with only your eggnog for company? The choice is yours!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2256780]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《Gachi: Christmas Party🎄》！这部视觉小说以欢乐的节日派对为背景，充满令人捧腹与温暖人心的时刻。你会在槲寄生下找到爱情，还是最后只剩蛋奶酒陪伴，独自过节？选择权在你手中！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2256780]Steam[/url]]
